hazards.reason: order.revision is renamed to order.rev, following Order.revision's @column: servers built from the previous version still use the old name.
hazards.subject: table/order/column/rev

statements:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_order_rev_fence" BEFORE UPDATE ON "order" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."rev" IS NOT OLD."rev" + 1 AND (
  NEW."rev" IS NOT OLD."rev"
  OR NEW."note" IS NOT OLD."note"
  OR NEW."customer_id" IS NOT OLD."customer_id")
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'order.rev is fenced: an update that changes a column it covers must add one to it, and any other must keep it or add one');
END
steps.subject: trigger/order/trg_order_rev_fence
